mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, it is a clear 42 degrees at the Verona Public Library. We have a full moon tonight, and the ISS will be visible from the northwest near Verona High School toward the northeast near Home Depot, staying low near the horizon for five minutes starting at 5:01 PM.

City of Verona offices will be closed November 26 and 27 for the Thanksgiving holiday. Please note that Thursday refuse and recycling pickup is delayed to Friday, November 27, and the recycling center will be closed those two days as well.

We have a busy schedule ahead with live music at Bailey's Run today and at Wisconsin Brewing Company on November 23. You can also join a class at Insight Wellness tomorrow or test your knowledge at various trivia nights starting November 25.
In a report from November 2, officers were dispatched to West End Circle regarding a domestic disturbance, resulting in the arrest of a 48-year-old man for battery and disorderly conduct.
Culver's is featuring the delicious OREO Cookie Overload today. They are currently open and will be serving until 10 PM tonight, so stop by for a scoop before they close.
